text: I am pleased to nominate Robert (Bobby) Long to serve as Judge on the U.S. District Court for the Middle District of Florida. Bobby is currently a Judge on Florida’s First District Court of Appeal. A longtime member of the Navy JAG Corps, Bobby was previously a Trial Judge on Florida’s Second Judicial Circuit Court and, prior to that, General Counsel of the Leon County Sheriff’s Office, where he was a Police Officer before becoming a lawyer. Bobby received his Law Degree from the University of Florida College of Law, and his Undergraduate Degree from Florida State University. Robert Long can always be counted on to protect the Public Safety and Constitutional Rights of Floridians. Congratulations Bobby! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am pleased to nominate Peter Mansfield, who has the strong support of Senator John Kennedy and Senator Bill Cassidy, to serve as Judge on the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana. Peter has been an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Orleans for more than twenty years, currently working as Chief of the Civil Division and, previously, as First Assistant. He received his Law Degree from Ave Maria School of Law, and his Undergraduate Degree from Franciscan University of Steubenville. The people of Louisiana are lucky to have a dedicated Public Servant like Peter join the Federal Bench. Congratulations Peter! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am pleased to nominate Brad Kelley to serve as Judge on the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana. Brad is a “Double-Tiger,” receiving both his Undergraduate and Law Degrees from LSU. He clerked for Judge Donald Walter of the Western District of Louisiana, was the former Chief Counsel to then EEOC Commissioner, now our Acting Secretary of Labor, Keith Sonderling, and now is a Partner at a major International Law Firm. Brad is also a proud U.S. Army Veteran, and has the strong support of both Louisiana’s Senators for this new position. The people of Louisiana can count on Brad to always protect their Constitutional Rights, and the Rule of Law. Congratulations Brad! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am pleased to nominate Daniel Ballou to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Kentucky. Dan is a longtime Circuit Judge for Kentucky’s 34th Judicial Circuit. He received his B.A. from the University of Kentucky, and his J.D. from the University of Mississippi School of Law, and previously clerked for Judge Eugene Siler of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit. Dan is also a Marine Corps Veteran — A True Patriot! I have no doubt that Daniel Ballou will be a powerful defender of the Rule of Law on the Federal Bench in the GREAT Commonwealth of Kentucky. Congratulations Dan! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am proud to nominate Richard Bennett to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Southern District of Texas. Richard has dedicated his career to protecting the Great People of Texas (A State I love, and won by the Biggest Vote Total in the History of the State, all three times!) working as a County Prosecutor, Assistant United States Attorney, Assistant Chief Counsel of ICE, and currently, as a Magistrate Judge on the Southern District of Texas. Richard is a Graduate of Texas Christian University and Southern Methodist University School of Law, and clerked for Judge Marcia Crone. A true warrior for Public Safety, Border Security, and our Constitution, Richard will deliver strong results in his new role. Congratulations Richard! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am pleased to nominate Courtney Coker to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas. Courtney has been a Federal Prosecutor for nearly 20 years, and is currently the First Assistant U.S. Attorney for the Northern District of Texas. He has prosecuted some of the toughest criminal cases in the Country, including against cartels, foreign gangs, and drug and human traffickers. Courtney is a Graduate of Centre College (where he was captain of the football team!), and Mississippi College School of Law. The people of Texas (I LOVE TEXAS!) are lucky to have such a strong defender of Law and Order on the Bench. Congratulations Courtney! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I have wonderful news for the Great State of Alaska — I am honored to nominate Kyle Reardon to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the District of Alaska. Kyle is currently a Magistrate Judge on the Federal Court in Alaska, and previously worked for many years as a Federal Prosecutor in Alaska and California, and as a Judge Advocate in the U.S. Army JAG Corps. He is a Graduate of the University of Virginia School of Law and Centre College. The people of Alaska are lucky to have a Public Servant and Patriot like Kyle on the Bench. Congratulations Kyle! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am pleased to nominate Zach West to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Northern District of Oklahoma, a place I love! Zach has been a zealous advocate for the Constitution, Religious Liberty, and the Rule of Law as Solicitor General of Oklahoma, and as Director of Special Litigation in the Oklahoma Attorney General’s Office. He clerked for Judge J. Leon Holmes of the Eastern District of Arkansas, and Judge Bobby Baldock of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. Zach is a double-Sooner, graduating from the University of Oklahoma, and the University of Oklahoma College of Law. A real fighter for the Great People of Oklahoma, Zach will never let you down. Congratulations Zach! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I am pleased to nominate Trevor Pemberton to serve as Judge on the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Oklahoma. I won Oklahoma all three times, with the Highest Vote Total ever recorded in the State’s History, and all 77 out of 77 Counties — SO OBVIOUSLY, I LOVE OKLAHOMA! Trevor received his J.D. from Oklahoma City University, and B.A. from the University of Oklahoma. Trevor will be a Strong Defender of the Constitutional Rights of all Oklahomans. Congratulations Trevor! President DONALD J. TRUMP
